title: Retain OpenRouter cost in Go producer results
notes: A local HTTP fixture returned OpenRouter usage with cost_usd, which was dropped by the Go producer client.
done_when: Include a successful OpenRouter result in the shared contract fixtures and assert that Go and Python preserve cost_usd.
result: Retain OpenRouter cost in Go producer results
evidence: Go contract and HTTP client tests verify absent, zero, and nonzero cost_usd values. The Python HTTP fixture test verifies the shared OpenRouter result.
